messages:
elaine-support: FYI — support seeing a spike of 502/504s from the hosted API in us-east-1 since ~10:12Z. ~30% error rate on /v1/generate. Multiple customers escalated for failed requests and timeouts. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: staged-release v2026.03.17-rc3 started rollout at 10:11Z. Traffic slice changed to 50% over 30m. Config diff: routing.policy=steer-prefetch-enabled=true (new routing variant selection).

marco-eng: I'm on it. Can someone paste gateway proxy logs for 10:10–10:20Z? Look for 'upstream reset' / 'proxy 502' patterns.

ryan-product: Customer Acme (enterprise tier) hit repeated 500s for bulk generation jobs. Payload sizes ~100–150KB. They reported timeouts then retries.

marco-eng: quick repro from my laptop: 
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @payload_120kb.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
-> immediate 502 with body 'gateway error: upstream reset'

marco-eng: gateway logs show entries: 
"error: upstream read ECONNRESET" 
"proxy returned 502 from inference-node-3" 
followed by repeated connection resets and a few pod restarts. Also see kvcache misses around the same window.

ashley-ops: infra tail shows inference-node-3 pod restarted at 10:10:58Z with OOMKilled. Node had increased memory footprint just before restart. Deploy rollout targeted variant-b pool which has lower memory limit.

elaine-support: some tickets show earlier 401 auths followed by retries that result in 502s. Not all failures are auth but enough that retries amplified load.

marco-eng: hypothesis: routing.policy change steered streaming/batched requests to a variant that doesn't support streaming payloads or has lower memory headroom. Large payloads cause backend worker OOM -> connections reset -> gateway 502/504.

marco-eng: immediate mitigations: reduce rollout weight to 0 for v2026.03.17-rc3 OR flip routing.policy steer-prefetch-enabled=false. We should also cordon the problematic variant-pool.

ashley-ops: starting rollback of staged release to v2026.03.16-stable now. Rolling traffic slice in us-east-1 from 50% -> 0%. ETA ~5m. I'll post once done.

deploy-bot: rollback command accepted by orchestration. Rolling back traffic weights in region us-east-1.

elaine-support: I'll notify affected customers with a status update and ask for any additional repro payloads.

marco-eng: engineering follow-ups (short): 1) add request-size validation in the gateway for /v1/generate, 2) ensure routing avoids non-streaming/non-oom-safe variants for streaming routes, 3) increase mem limits or add backpressure on that variant pool, 4) add canary health checks that include large-payload synthetic requests.

ryan-product: CS note: some customers retried and saw duplicate billable tokens. Please coordinate billing credits with support and flag affected accounts for manual review.

ashley-ops: rollback complete in us-east-1 at 10:20Z. Post-rollback telemetry shows errors dropping toward baseline. Continuing verification in other regions.

sre-oncall: verified metrics: per-route 5xx in us-east-1 dropped from ~32% at peak to ~1.5% in 10m post-rollback. No elevated 5xx in us-west-2 after checking.

elaine-support: thanks. I'll consolidate thread into an incident ticket and open a postmortem. Action items for PM/Eng/Infra/CS assigned in ticket: prevention, variant-stability gating, billing reconciliation, and improved canary synthetic tests.

marco-eng: adding alert: create rule for sudden per-route error-rate delta >5% within 5m and suppress noisy alerts from transient retries.

ryan-product: noted. Closing escalations once billing and CS messages are sent. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ashley-ops: leaving a reminder to run a controlled re-deploy only after adding request-size guard and variant mem increase. No re-rollout until patch is merged and unit tests pass.

elaine-support: I will update the support queue and mark open tickets as 'investigating' -> 'mitigated' after billing check. Incident lead: marco-eng. Postmortem owner: ryan-product.
